problem_statement: We upgraded to warehouse client 2.x and every erasure request now fails in staging with `AttributeError: 'WarehouseClient' object has no attribute 'delete_customer'`. Client 2.x removed `delete_customer` and `null_columns` in favour of a single `erase(customer_id, columns=None)` call that returns a receipt. Please migrate `erasure/monitored_executor.py` to the new API following the examples in `reference/`. Result records should also carry the `erasure_id` from the receipt so support can trace tickets back to the warehouse. The tests in `tests/` already use the 2.x client.

Since moving to warehouse client 2.x, all erasure requests in staging fail with `AttributeError: 'WarehouseClient' object has no attribute 'delete_customer'`. In 2.x, `delete_customer` and `null_columns` were dropped and replaced by one `erase(customer_id, columns=None)` call that returns a receipt. Please port `erasure/monitored_executor.py` to the new API, using the examples in `reference/` as a guide. Result records should also include the `erasure_id` from the receipt so that support can trace tickets back to the warehouse. The tests in `tests/` are already written against the 2.x client.

The 2.x client no longer has `delete_customer` or `null_columns`; both were replaced by a single `erase(customer_id, columns=None)` call, which returns a receipt. We need `erasure/monitored_executor.py` migrated to this new API, following the examples under `reference/`. In addition, result records should carry the `erasure_id` from the receipt so support can trace tickets back to the warehouse. Note that the tests in `tests/` already use the 2.x client.
